subject: Retroactive usage reconciliation & one-time settlement — BrightPost Data
messages:
From: Ayesha Kumar <ayesha.kumar@brightpost.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPost Finance <finance@brightpost.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected retro usage on Oct/Nov — need reconciliation

Hi Evelyn / Marcus,

We noticed a set of usage spikes dated Oct 28–Nov 4 that were billed against our account after the renewal went through. Our finance team flagged a one-time retroactive charge that pushed us over the committed capacity for Q4. Can you share the raw billing/usage breakdown and a proposed settlement path? We prefer a single one-time invoice rather than amending the committed capacity for the full term.

I've attached the excerpt our billing team pulled (BP-usage-q4-retro.xlsx) and copied Daniel from my finance team.

Requested next steps:
- Short reconciliation of the token/embedding delta by day
- A settlement amount proposal (one-time fee) and invoice ETA
- Confirmation this won't change our ongoing committed unit count

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Ayesha Kumar
Head of Data Products
BrightPost Data

Attachments: BP-usage-q4-retro.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet with daily usage rows)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Kumar <ayesha.kumar@brightpost.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected retro usage on Oct/Nov — need reconciliation

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the sheet. We've pulled the request traces and KV-cache misses for the Oct 28–Nov 4 window and are seeing a short burst of higher-seq-length generations from three API keys that were still on the old routing policy.

Quick plan: Marcus will validate the per-key breakdown and Monica (FP&A) will craft a settlement figure that aligns with our committed pricing tables but as a one-time charge. I will confirm the invoice timing and ensure this is treated as a retro settlement (does not adjust committed capacity).

Can you confirm the BrightPost billing contact for invoice delivery — is finance@brightpost.com the right mailbox? Also, do you prefer net-30 or net-45?

I'll aim to get a proposal over by EOD Monday. If you want a short sync, propose Mon 11/23 10a PT.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

--
Evelyn Hart | Director, Customer Success | evelln.hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ayesha Kumar <ayesha.kumar@brightpost.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Unexpected retro usage on Oct/Nov — draft settlement math

Monica / Evelyn — initial reconciliation attached (BP-usage-q4-retro.xlsx) with my annotated tab. Summary:
- Retro delta: 1,126,400 tokens over the committed band for Oct 28–Nov 4
- Equivalent billable units (per BP pricing profile): 1,126 tokens => 1 unit at tiered pricing; effective unit delta = 1,126 (rounded)
- Suggested one-time settlement = $7,950 (applies Redwood hosted per-token rate at committed discount)

Notes/questions for BrightPost:
- Offer a 10% goodwill discount if they sign the settlement within 7 days
- Invoice terms: standard net-30; can accommodate net-45 on request

I flagged this with Grace for legal review re: any contract amendment language. Evelyn — happy to join a quick call if BrightPost wants walkthrough.

Attachments: redwood-settlement-proposal.pdf (one-page proposal and invoice stub)

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ayesha Kumar <ayesha.kumar@brightpost.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@brightpost.com>, BrightPost Finance <finance@brightpost.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected retro usage on Oct/Nov — draft settlement math

Thanks Marcus and team — the math looks reasonable. A couple quick points from Finance:
- We appreciate the 10% early-sign discount; can you confirm final amount after the discount?
- Invoice should go to finance@brightpost.com and use purchase order PO-87921 for reference.
- We prefer net-45 for large one-time charges; please indicate that on the invoice.

We'll route the settlement doc internally and aim to return a signed copy by Wednesday EOD. If you can update the PDF with the PO and net-45 terms, we can speed approvals.

Also, confirm that this settlement is purely retrospective and won't alter our committed unit count for the remainder of the 12-month term.

Best,
Ayesha

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Unexpected retro usage on Oct/Nov — settlement invoice issued

Hi Ayesha — appreciate the quick review. Per your ask we've applied the 10% early-sign discount. Final one-time settlement amount = $7,155.

Actions taken:
- Invoice INV-RED-2026-1155 created with PO-87921 and net-45 terms
- DocuSign envelope prepared: DocuSign: 0f3a9b7c-brightpost-settlement (link included above)
- This charge is marked in our billing system as "retro settlement" and will not modify BrightPost's committed capacity for the term.

Please sign the DocuSign by EOD Friday to capture the early-sign discount. Once signed, accounting will issue the invoice PDF and we can schedule payment processing.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if you want a line-by-line walkthrough.

Warm regards,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations — Billing Lead
Redwood Inference
